name: How much does pool deck resurfacing typically cost in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How much does pool deck resurfacing typically cost in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of pool deck resurfacing in Las Vegas varies significantly based on factors like the size of the deck, the condition of the existing surface, and the type of material chosen. Basic overlays might start lower, while more decorative or specialized finishes can increase the price. We provide a detailed, no-obligation estimate after assessing your specific pool deck and discussing material options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on deck size, current condition, and material choice. A detailed estimate is provided after assessment.
